description: This source file implements the RialtoGStreamerMSEAudioSink class, which is a GStreamer element for handling audio sinks in Rialto's media streaming environment. It manages state changes, creates media sources based on caps, handles events for attaching audio sources, and exposes properties like volume and mute. The class interacts with media pipeline capabilities and media player clients to facilitate audio streaming in a media playback pipeline.

classes.name: RialtoMSEAudioSink
classes.description: A GStreamer element class for Rialto's media streaming audio sink, handling state transitions, media source creation, event processing, and property management for audio streams.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_change_state
methods.description: Handles state changes for the audio sink, attaching media player clients and configuring stream info when transitioning from READY to PAUSED.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_create_media_source
methods.description: Creates a media source object based on the provided GstCaps, configuring audio parameters and mime type.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_event
methods.description: Processes incoming events on the sink pad, particularly attaching media sources when caps are received.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_get_property
methods.description: Retrieves properties such as volume and mute status from the media player client.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_set_property
methods.description: Sets properties such as volume and mute status on the media player client.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_qos_handle
methods.description: Handles QoS (Quality of Service) messages, posting QoS stats to the GStreamer bus.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_init
methods.description: Initializes the audio sink, setting up sink pad functions and QoS callback.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_class_init
methods.description: Class initialization for the RialtoMSEAudioSink, setting up properties, state change function, and supported mime types.
